title: Crochet Swiss Roll Cake Slice
name: Swiss Roll Slice
seoTitle: Crochet Swiss Roll Cake Slice Pattern (Free PDF)
description: Free crochet swiss roll cake slice pattern: two dc strips rolled into a spiral, topped with whipped cream, a cherry and a leaf. Printable PDF for play food.
lead: A sweet slice of swiss roll for play food or a keychain. Two long strips of dc are rolled together into a spiral, then topped with a cream swirl, a cherry and a little leaf.
yarn: Cotton yarn in a cake colour, white, red and green

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn: cake colour (brown or pink), white, red and green
A pinch of stuffing for the cherry

notes: A 3-dc cluster: work 3 dc in the same st, stopping each one when 2 loops are left, then yarn over and pull through all 4 loops.

rounds.text: With the cake colour: ch 50. Working in the back loops only, skip 2 ch, dc in each ch, leaving the last back loop.
ch 3 and sl st into the last back loop. Cut the yarn.
With white: ch 48. Skip 2 ch, dc in each ch, leaving the last 2 loops.
ch 2, sl st in the last loop. Cut the yarn.
With white: magic ring, ch 1, 10 sc in the ring, sl st.
ch 1, (sc, 3-dc cluster in next st) x5. Fasten off.
With red: magic ring, ch 1, 6 sc (no sl st, work in a spiral).
(sc, dec) x4. Stuff, ch 1 and cut the yarn.
With green: ch 6. Skip 1 ch, sl st, hdc, hdc, (sl st, ch 1, sl st) in the next ch, hdc, dc, hdc, sl st, sl st, ch 1. Fasten off.

finishing: Lay the white strip on top of the cake strip and roll them up tightly together into a spiral.
Sew the end of the roll in place so it does not unroll.
Sew the whipped cream on top, the cherry on the cream and the leaf next to the cherry.
